name: Sticky Header, Footer, Section, Logo & Back to Top Button for Elementor
author: Bhumi

sections.description:
Sticky Elementor is a lightweight and powerful plugin that lets you make any Elementor container sticky — including headers, sections, navigation bars, call-to-action blocks, and even logos.

Built for full compatibility with Elementor’s Flexbox container system, it offers advanced scroll effects, sticky triggers, entrance animations, and responsive visibility.

🚀 Key Features

  • Add a customizable Back to Top button with scroll animation
  • Make any container sticky (top, middle, bottom positions)
  • Sticky headers, logos, toolbars, or promo bars
  • Customize top offset, padding, background, width
  • Add entrance animations: fade, slide, zoom, etc.
  • Add rotation effects (X, Y) on scroll
  • Use sticky trigger points for scroll-based activation
  • Full responsive control (desktop, tablet, mobile)
  • Works seamlessly with Elementor Flexbox containers
  • Optimized with minimal JS & CSS for top performance
  • Built-in support for shrinking logos and logo color change on scroll
  • Add your Instagram support contact for instant help

Whether you’re building a sticky header, floating section, or a smart scroll-based container — this plugin makes it fast and easy, without needing Elementor Pro.

Why Use This Plugin?

Sticky Elementor helps you easily build advanced sticky effects — like sticky headers, logos, toolbars, or sections — without writing a single line of code. Whether you’re building modern UI layouts or interactive call-to-actions, this plugin keeps your elements visible and animated on scroll — perfectly aligned with Elementor’s new Flexbox containers.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Edit any page using Elementor.
  4. Select a container → Go to Advanced tab → Sticky Settings.
  5. Enable sticky and customize options like position, animation, logo shrink, etc.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with Elementor’s Flexbox Containers?

Yes! It’s fully compatible and optimized for the Flexbox system.

Can I use this with free Elementor?

Absolutely. No Elementor Pro required.

Can I make the logo shrink or change color on scroll?

Yes — logo shrink and color filter options are included.

Will this affect my site’s performance?

Not at all. It uses minimal and optimized JavaScript and CSS.

Can I show support contact or a help message?

Yes — a support notice control lets you add custom help info, like an Instagram DM link.

  • Improved: Enhanced UI/UX of Elementor controls for Sticky Settings.
  • Improved: Transition smoothness for logo height and filter changes.

1.0.6

  • Improved: JS code structure, readability, and performance for better long-term maintenance.

1.0.5

  • Fixed: Admin bar height is now properly included in the sticky offset—ensuring perfect alignment when logged in.
  • Improved: Sticky behavior now fully respects responsive breakpoints — individual offset, padding, background, and rotation per device (desktop, tablet, mobile).

  • Enhanced: Transform handling now gracefully resets on scroll-out for a smoother user experience.
